question: The speed of a train including stoppages is 75 kmph and excluding stoppages, the speed of the train is 90 kmph. For how many minutes does the train stop per hour?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Stoppage time per hour = [(Faster Speed − Slower Speed) ÷ Faster Speed] × 60 min

Stoppage time per hour = [(90 − 75) ÷ 90] × 60

Stoppage time per hour = (15 ÷ 90) × 60

Stoppage time per hour = (1 ÷ 6) × 60 = 10 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 10 minutes.**
